d:
Nisha bhagat ki maut ke mamle men rashtriy mahila aayog ne jharkhand sarkar aur pulis prashasan ki karyashaili par ganbhir saval uthae hain. ranchi aur gumla daure par pahunchin aayog ki adhyaksh ne nisha bhagat ke parijnon se mulakat ki aur unhen nyay dilane ka bharosa diya.
